data.name: POSTERIOR
data.detailed_description:
You Are Not a Pilot. You Are the Balance.

In Posterior, you are a space trader inside a production capsule stationed in the depths of space.

Your mission is simple:

Supply starships.
Earn money.
Build your colony.

But nothing here is weightless.

⚖ Real Weight. Real Consequences.

Every material inside your capsule has physical weight.
Every movement shifts the balance.

When you carry cargo:

  • The capsule tilts

  • The center of gravity shifts

  • Stability breaks

If you fail to control the balance, chaos begins.

Deliveries become harder.
Loads become heavier.
Precision becomes survival.

🚢 Trade With Passing Starships

Starships arrive with dynamic requests.

They demand materials such as:

  • Reactor components

  • Heat shield alloys

  • Rare radioactive elements

  • Experimental space technologies

Your task:
Find the requested materials, stack them, and deliver them while keeping your capsule stable.

The more you trade, the more complex the balance becomes.

🏗 Infinite Production System

At the center of your capsule lies an endless elevator system.

Materials are constantly produced and sent downward.

Your job is to:

  • Receive incoming materials

  • Physically stack them

  • Distribute weight evenly

  • Prevent imbalance

This is not an inventory game.

This is physical survival.

🌍 Build Your Colony

Earn money through successful deliveries.

Upgrade your capsule:

  • Stabilization systems

  • Interior expansion

  • Production efficiency

  • Advanced materials

Transform your fragile capsule into a self-sustaining space colony.

🎯 Core Gameplay Features

  • Weight-based physics system

  • Dynamic balance management

  • Increasing difficulty

  • Endless production loop

  • Strategic stacking

  • Risk vs reward trading

🔥 The More You Earn, The Harder It Gets

Growth is risky.

As production increases:

  • Loads become heavier

  • Orders become more complex

  • Balance becomes harder to maintain

Profit creates instability.

Can you build an empire without collapsing under your own weight?

data.short_description: You are a space trader living inside a capsule in deep space. Supply passing starships, maintain balance in a weight-based physics system, and build your own space colony.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470 or AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 or AMD Radeon R9 390
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS:
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or Apple M1
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Plus / Radeon Pro 555 / Apple M1 GPU
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:

  • OS:
  • Processor: Apple M1 Pro / M1 Max or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 Pro / M1 Max GPU
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains non-graphic psychological horror elements.
Players may experience distorted visuals, time perception manipulation, intense sound effects, and a tense, oppressive atmosphere that may be unsettling for some audiences.

The game does not include graphic violence, blood, sexual content, nudity, drug use, alcohol use, self-harm, or suicide.

All disturbing elements are abstract and psychological in nature, focusing on perception, time pressure, and mental tension rather than physical harm.
